p_wolfion_ankle_black.description: A low-cut ankle sock for an invisible fit under sneakers and loafers. Premium combed cotton, ribbed cuff, and the signature woven WOLFION wordmark. Stays put thanks to a snug heel cup.
p_wolfion_ankle_black.name: Wolfion Ankle Black

p_wolfion_ankle_white.description: A crisp white low-cut ankle sock that disappears under any low-top shoe. Combed cotton, ribbed cuff, and the woven WOLFION wordmark on the cuff. Anti-slip heel for a no-bunch fit.
p_wolfion_ankle_white.name: Wolfion Ankle White

p_wolfion_classic_black.description: A premium short sock that sits just above the ankle bone. Soft pima cotton with a subtle satin sheen, fine ribbed cuff, hand-linked toe seam, and the WOLFION wordmark embroidered in tonal silver thread. Refined enough to wear with leather shoes, comfortable enough for everyday.
p_wolfion_classic_black.name: Wolfion Classic Black

p_wolfion_classic_grey.description: A premium heather-grey short sock that sits just above the ankle bone. Soft pima cotton in a subtle marled finish, fine ribbed cuff, hand-linked toe seam, and the WOLFION wordmark embroidered in tonal silver thread. The everyday short sock, refined.
p_wolfion_classic_grey.name: Wolfion Classic Grey

p_wolfion_classic_white.description: A premium short sock in crisp white that sits just above the ankle bone. Soft pima cotton with subtle satin sheen, fine ribbed cuff, hand-linked toe seam, and the WOLFION wordmark embroidered in tonal black thread. Looks polished with low-tops, sneakers, or leather loafers.
p_wolfion_classic_white.name: Wolfion Classic White

p_wolfion_kids_blue.description: A soft sky-blue striped kids crew sock built for play. Cotton blend with a stretchy ribbed cuff, the friendly WOLFION wordmark on the cuff, and a seamless toe so little feet stay happy all day.
p_wolfion_kids_blue.name: Wolfion Kids Blue

p_wolfion_kids_pink.description: A soft-pink kids crew sock with a tiny star pattern. Cotton blend, gentle ribbed cuff, and the WOLFION wordmark on the cuff. Cute, durable, and machine-washable for everyday adventures.
p_wolfion_kids_pink.name: Wolfion Kids Pink

p_wolfion_premium_camel.description: A chunky cable-knit boot sock in warm cream, knit from substantial merino wool with prominent vertical cabling and a thick folded cuff. Cozy enough for cabin weekends, refined enough for a tailored boot. WOLFION wordmark hand-embroidered on the cuff in tonal sage thread.
p_wolfion_premium_camel.name: Wolfion Wool Cream Cable

p_wolfion_premium_navy.description: A thin silk-blend dress sock in deep bordeaux wine, with a subtle satin sheen, fine vertical rib, and the WOLFION wordmark woven into the cuff in antique gold thread. The finishing piece for a tailored suit — refined, lustrous, and designed to lay flat under leather lace-ups.
p_wolfion_premium_navy.name: Wolfion Silk Bordeaux

p_wolfion_premium_onyx.description: A mid-calf sock spun from a sumptuous cashmere blend in deep charcoal. Brushed for warmth, ribbed for stay-up comfort, finished with a hand-linked toe seam and the WOLFION wordmark woven into the cuff in champagne-gold thread. The kind of sock that feels like an heirloom from day one.
p_wolfion_premium_onyx.name: Wolfion Cashmere Charcoal
